run_compute_tangent_field: run vector.compute_tangent_field to compute a tangent field from a 2D array using Fourier expansion and lattice vectors
run_compute_field_pol: run vector.compute_field_pol to compute a polar tangent field from a 2D array with a given basis expansion
run_compute_field_jones_direct: run vector.compute_field_jones_direct to compute a Jones direct tangent field from a 2D array with basis coefficients
run_normalize_vector_field: run vector.normalize_elementwise, vector.normalize, or vector.normalize_jones to normalize a 2D vector field array
run_vector_field_schemes: run vector.VECTOR_FIELD_SCHEMES to compute tangent fields using any registered scheme from the schemes dictionary
